name: C00/C07 PRD consultant template
source: Rockbox-derived 12-section PRD structure, de-productized into a generic consultant template.
purpose: Guide a human through an expert PRD workflow until the document is sufficient for C01-C06 handoff.

ai_workflow_skill: separate facts, assumptions, decisions, and external confirmations
human_or_external: confirm commercial, compliance, schedule, and responsibility claims

sections.title: 1. Company Vision & Business Strategy
sections.purpose: Explain why the product exists, who it serves, and how it fits the business.
consultant_prompts: Who is the first real customer or user for this product?
What business outcome proves this product is worth building?
Which claim must the PRD avoid until customer or legal approval?

sections.title: 2. Project Overall
sections.purpose: Summarize the product concept, operating environment, major functions, and package scope.
consultant_prompts: Describe the product in one sentence as if briefing an engineering manager.
Where will the product be used physically and environmentally?
What tempting feature is explicitly out of scope for this version?

sections.title: 3. Project Objectives
sections.purpose: Convert product intent into measurable objectives and acceptance criteria.
consultant_prompts: Which three outcomes must be true for POC success?
Which objective is allowed to be weak in POC but not in EVT/DVT?
What measurable signal proves the main function works?

sections.title: 4. System Architecture
sections.purpose: Define the product's subsystem map and main data/power/control flows.
consultant_prompts: What are the required compute, sensing, connectivity, power, storage, and UI blocks?
Which subsystem choice is already fixed by business or supply constraints?
Which architecture decision needs evidence before schematic work begins?

sections.title: 5. ID / Mechanical Requirements
sections.purpose: Provide the constraints that allow ID and ME teams to start without guessing product intent.
consultant_prompts: What physical size or enclosure constraint must the electronics respect?
Which connectors, camera, microphone, display, buttons, or LEDs are user-facing?
What must ID/ME decide before PCB placement can be safe?

sections.title: 6. Electrical Requirements
sections.purpose: Define enough electrical intent for C03 circuit design kickoff and downstream verification.
consultant_prompts: Which MCU/SoC/module choices are fixed, preferred, or still open?
What power source, battery, charging, and runtime assumptions are required?
Which electrical interface must be correct for firmware and mechanical teams?

sections.title: 7. Software Requirements
sections.purpose: Extend PRD functionality into a C05 software-development spec boundary without writing firmware code.
consultant_prompts: What should the product do from power-on to normal operation?
Which behaviors belong in firmware versus app, cloud, or manufacturing tools?
Which C03 pin or interface decisions block the FW spec?

sections.title: 8. Role & Responsibility
sections.purpose: Make ownership explicit so AI, user, engineers, vendors, and labs do not silently assume work belongs to someone else.
consultant_prompts: Who approves PRD, circuit, layout, FW spec, verification plan, and factory release?
Which deliverables are bodesign-assisted versus engineer/vendor-owned?
Who is responsible when a handoff has an unresolved assumption?

sections.title: 9. Assumption & Constraints
sections.purpose: Record assumptions, constraints, risks, and accepted gaps instead of hiding them in generated prose.
consultant_prompts: Which assumption would be expensive if wrong?
What evidence is missing but required before EVT/DVT?
Which gap can proceed as accepted risk and which blocks handoff?

sections.title: 10. Project Management
sections.purpose: Define milestone flow, deliverables, review cadence, and approval gates.
consultant_prompts: Is the immediate milestone POC, EVT, DVT, or production release?
Which artifact must be approved before money is spent externally?
How should requirement changes be handled after schematic kickoff?

sections.title: 11. Project High-level Schedule
sections.purpose: Capture target timing and dependency order without pretending estimates are guarantees.
consultant_prompts: What date matters, and what happens if it slips?
Which external lead time is most likely to dominate the schedule?
Which downstream team must start first after PRD approval?

sections.title: 12. Company & Vendor Team Roster
sections.purpose: List teams, vendors, contacts, and escalation paths needed to execute the PRD.
consultant_prompts: Who will receive each handoff package?
Which vendor or lab must be contacted before the next milestone?
Who has final authority to approve the PRD?

documents.conditional_when: wireless, cellular, RF, BLE, Wi-Fi, antenna, or certification target is present
